name: trakt_account
description: Read authenticated Trakt account context without changing the account. Use for personalized Trakt movie or TV recommendations, watchlist, viewing history, ratings, favorites, personal lists, smart lists, up-next progress, or to add optional account-aware context to movie-night and TV-night requests. This tool is strictly read-only: it cannot add, remove, rate, mark watched, create lists, or mutate Trakt. It requires a Trakt Client Secret and a local OAuth cache created with ./bin/trakt-auth; users with only TRAKT_API_KEY should use trakt_movies or trakt_tv_shows instead. OAuth access and Trakt VIP capability are separate: most reads only require an authorized account, while Trakt may return explicit VIP-only or VIP Enhanced responses for restricted endpoints or limits.

action.description: Read-only account operation. Use the *_night_context actions when complementing the matching workflow or a natural-language viewing request.

request.description: Natural-language viewing request used to infer genres and runtime for movie_night_context or tv_night_context.

public_candidates.description: Bounded public Trakt candidates handed off by a night workflow. The account tool compares their stable IDs with the authorized account's watched sync and returns only eligible candidates; raw watched rows are never returned.

media_type.description: Media collection type for watchlist, history, ratings, favorites, or list-item reads. Defaults to movies. Favorites only supports movies or shows.

list_id.description: Trakt list slug or ID returned by personal_lists or smart_lists; required for a list-items action.

genres.description: Optional Trakt genre slugs for recommendation actions.

years.description: Optional recommendation year or range, such as 1990-2026.

runtimes.description: Optional runtime range in minutes. For shows this means typical episode runtime.

ignore_watched.description: Exclude watched titles from recommendation actions. Defaults true.

ignore_collected.description: Exclude collected titles from recommendation actions. Defaults false.

ignore_watchlisted.description: Exclude watchlisted titles from recommendation actions. Defaults false.

sort_by.description: Sort mode for collection endpoints that support it. Defaults rank.

sort_how.description: Sort direction for collection endpoints that support it. Defaults asc.

include_stats.description: Request progress statistics for up_next when supported. Defaults true.

availability.setup_hint: Set Trakt Client ID, Client Secret, and the registered redirect URI in the active mode env file, then run ./bin/trakt-auth --mode cloud (or local). The recommended device-flow redirect is urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob.
